title: Tally and HubSpot Integration
seoTitle: Tally HubSpot Integration: Deals to Invoices in Tally
seoDescription: Connect HubSpot deals and companies with TallyPrime so won deals become vouchers and sales sees outstanding balances. What syncs, set-up and costs.
summary: A Tally–HubSpot integration turns won HubSpot deals into sales orders or invoices in TallyPrime and brings each customer's outstanding balance and payment status back into HubSpot, so sales conversations reflect what accounts knows.

dataPoints.label: HubSpot side
dataPoints.value: CRM API for companies, contacts and deals, plus webhooks on deal stage changes

dataPoints.label: Tally side
dataPoints.value: TallyPrime XML interface via a connector on the Tally machine

dataPoints.label: What syncs
dataPoints.value: Companies to ledgers, won deals to vouchers, balances and last payment back to HubSpot

dataPoints.label: Matching key
dataPoints.value: GSTIN on the company record to avoid duplicate ledgers

body:
## Design choices

- Trigger: deal marked won, or a later approval stage.
- Which system creates the customer first, and how GSTIN is captured.
- How often balances refresh in HubSpot.

## Why it helps

Sales stops offering credit to overdue customers, and accounts sees upcoming orders early. See [custom CRM vs Zoho vs HubSpot](/blog/custom-crm-vs-zoho-vs-hubspot-for-indian-smes).

faqs.q: Can line items and GST carry across?
faqs.a: Yes, if HubSpot products and tax settings match Tally stock items and GST rates; the integration can keep them aligned.

faqs.q: Does this need HubSpot's paid plans?
faqs.a: API access is available on free and paid tiers, with limits; custom properties and workflows may need paid tiers.
